title: GTA 6 cops track THESE things 👮 #gta6 #shorts
description: GTA 6's police tracking: icons under your wanted stars show what cops know about you. Sources: GamesRadar, Beebom, GTABase.

scenes.say: In GTA 6, the cops remember what you're wearing.
Number three. Your car. Get spotted, and cops know what you're driving.
Number two. Your clothes. Change your fit, lose the heat.
Number one. Security cameras. If CCTV catches you, there's an icon for that.
And the wanted level goes all the way to six stars.
What's your best way to lose the cops?
